title: Girder end moments with the real columns above and below

answer_format.end_moment_kNm: number (hogging at the column centreline, magnitude)

rubric.text: The response should use 0.70 Ig for the columns and 0.35 Ig for the girder, share the fixed-end moment at each joint between the two columns and the girder by stiffness (the girder at 2EI/L for the symmetric case), and not treat the ends as pinned or fully fixed.

expert_notes: FEM = 41.02 x 81/12 = 276.9 kN.m. Columns: 2 x 4E(0.70 x 0.005208)/3.75 = 7.778e-3 E; girder (symmetric) 2E(0.35 x 0.0072)/9 = 0.560e-3 E. End moment 276.9 x 7.778/8.338 = 258.3; midspan 415.3 - 258.3 = 157.0. Pinned ends give 415.3 at midspan and no column moment; fixed ends 276.9 and 138.4 (midspan 12% low). Gross stiffness for all members gives 242.0 / 173.3, outside the tolerance: the cracked factors matter here. The face moment (not asked) would be 258.3 - 184.6 x 0.25 + 41.02 x 0.25^2/2 = 213.4.
